 Six killed, others injured in shootout at Guwahati hotel, police say culprit will be nabbed soon
 SECTIONS Six killed, others injured in shootout at Guwahati hotel, police say culprit will be nabbed soon By Bikash Singh , ET Bureau Last Updated: Oct 26, 2026, 10:45:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis A violent shootout occurred in a hotel in Guwahati, leading to the deaths of six individuals. Among the deceased were two women, and several others suffered critical injuries. Authorities, including the police commissioner, have confirmed the recovery of four bodies for postmortem examination. A manhunt has been initiated in response to the incident, targeting areas such as railway stations.

 Four killed, others injured in shootout at Guwahati hotel, police say culprit will be nabbed soon
 Guwahati: Six people are killed and others are injured in a shootout in a hotel in Guwahati. The incident has sent shock waves in the city.
 A police team has rushed to the area. The incident took place around 8. 30 pm. Among those there are two women.
Partha Sarathi Mahanta, Guwahati police commissioner told media persons on Monday, “We have recovered four bodies, and they are sent for postmortem examination. We will soon nab the culprit.” 
A police official said, " The injured who are rushed to hospital are critically injured." 
A police officer said that two people were rushed following the bullet injuries and both of them succumbed to their injuries. Police has launched manhunt in the Railway stations."
 Live Events
 Guwahati, the financial hub of Northeast India has not witnessed such shootings in recent years.
 The insurgency has been wanning, and these incidents take place when insurgency was at its heights in 1990’s.
